templates.title: Capen Victor Mural Paint-Out
templates.motive: Rival week. They wanted Victor embarrassed before the game.
templates.solvePath: Somebody painted red over the Victor mural on the Capen south wall between 4:40 and 5:10 PM.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Capen Hall, south brick wall.
WHEN: 4:40 PM to 5:10 PM.
WHAT: Somebody's painted red over the Victor the Bull mural. The horns are the only original paint left.
MOTIVE: Rival week. They wanted Victor embarrassed before the game.

South-wall camera still. A directory jacket, a lanyard, hands on a roller, face turned away. Horns still blue.
Afternoon tabling sheet from inside Capen. A signature at 3:10 PM and no time out.
Founders tabling crew list.
Lobby camera still at the coffee cart, 4:20 PM.
Campus-store receipt. One tube of cadmium-red acrylic, 3:40 PM.
templates.accessDescription: South-wall camera CP-S2, 4:52 PM. {name}'s directory jacket, lanyard readable, both hands on a roller over Victor. Face turned away. Horns still blue.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} painted red over the Victor mural on the Capen south wall.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the afternoon tabling sheet inside Capen at 3:10 PM. No time out on the line.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is on the Founders tabling crew list.
templates.alibiDescription: Lobby camera CP-L1, 4:20 PM. {name} at the coffee cart.
templates.redHerringDescription: Campus-store receipt on {name}'s card. One tube of cadmium-red acrylic, 3:40 PM.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} bought the acrylic for a club table. The tube's still sealed in the poster bin.
templates.statementTemplate: I wasn't on the south wall. I was inside Capen.

templates.title: Norton Hall Cloned Night Badge
templates.motive: A recommendation letter locked in a faculty office.
templates.solvePath: Somebody opened a Norton faculty office at 9:22 PM on chip serial SE-B.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Norton Hall, faculty hallway.
WHEN: 9:05 PM to 9:40 PM.
WHAT: Somebody opened a locked faculty office after the hallway had gone quiet.
MOTIVE: A recommendation letter locked in that office. They wanted a look at it.

Door reader log, faculty hallway, 9:22 PM. A chip serial, SE-B.
Encode bench 2 sign-in sheet, 4:00 PM to 4:30 PM.
Encode ticket EJ-77. Chip serial SE-B written at 4:16 PM. Operator line blank.
Alumni gym photo, 9:20 PM.
Hallway master-key checkout. Out at 8:40 PM, back at 9:50 PM.
templates.accessDescription: Norton door reader NRT-2, 9:22 PM. The door opened for a chip carrying {name}'s printed number. The chip serial on the read is SE-B.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} wrote chip SE-B on encode bench 2 and used it on the Norton faculty door at 9:22 PM.
templates.signInDescription: {name} is on the encode bench 2 sheet from 4:00 PM to 4:30 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: Ticket EJ-77. One blank written to chip serial SE-B at 4:16 PM. The operator line is blank. {name} is on bench 2's sheet for that half hour.
templates.alibiDescription: Alumni gym photo, 9:20 PM. A hoodie like {name}'s. The scan on the photo is guest pass G-19, issued at 9:18 PM under a different name.
templates.redHerringDescription: {name} signed a hallway master key out at 8:40 PM and back in at 9:50 PM.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} used that key to lock Capen classrooms after an event. It came back to the cabinet.
templates.statementTemplate: My card was in my pocket the whole time. I was at the gym.

templates.title: Hadley Village Unit 4B Noise Sheet
templates.motive: A recruit visit turned into a party. The host needed the write-up on somebody else.
templates.solvePath: Somebody was in the Hadley 4B doorway at 11:36 PM with a case of cans.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Hadley Village, unit 4B.
WHEN: 10:40 PM to 12:10 AM.
WHAT: Residents called in a party. Music, cans in the hall, and a recruit who wasn't supposed to stay the night.
MOTIVE: A recruit visit turned into a party. The host needed the write-up on somebody else.

Bodycam still in the 4B doorway, 11:36 PM. A person, a case of cans, music behind them.
Laundry clipboard. A signature at 11:20 PM.
Unit 4B guest line.
Laundry machine log.
Tops receipt. Two sleeves of red cups, 6:10 PM.
templates.accessDescription: Hadley bodycam HV-4, 11:36 PM. {name} in the unit 4B doorway, one hand on a case of cans. Music's going behind them.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} was in the Hadley 4B doorway at 11:36 PM with the cans.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Hadley laundry clipboard at 11:20 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is on the unit 4B guest line, written as someone who might stop by.
templates.alibiDescription: Hadley laundry machine log. No cycle under {name} between 11:00 PM and midnight.
templates.redHerringDescription: Tops receipt, 6:10 PM. {name} bought two sleeves of red cups.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} bought the cups for a floor program. The program sheet accounts for both sleeves.
templates.statementTemplate: I was in the laundry room. I didn't host anything in 4B.

templates.title: Furnas Chem 201 Night Reprint
templates.motive: The Chem 201 midterm is at 8 AM. Fail it and you fail the course.
templates.solvePath: Somebody printed {name}-review.pdf in Furnas 214 at 1:17 AM.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Furnas Hall, room 214.
WHEN: 1:04 AM to 1:28 AM.
WHAT: Somebody reprinted the Chem 201 answer key off a lab computer. The login on the job is the shared night account.
MOTIVE: The midterm's at 8 AM. Fail it and you fail the course.

Print job, 1:17 AM. A review file on the shared login chem-night.
Room 214 tablet. Signed out at 1:06 AM.
chem-night clearance list.
Door badge. Exit at 1:22 AM.
USB from the lobby lost-and-found. Sticker reads 201-KEY.
templates.accessDescription: Furnas terminal LC-2, 1:17 AM. It sent {name}-review.pdf to the room 214 printer. The login on the job is chem-night.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} printed the Chem 201 key in Furnas 214 at 1:17 AM.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the room 214 tablet out at 1:06 AM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is cleared on the shared login chem-night, with the rest of the night section.
templates.alibiDescription: Furnas door badge for {name}. Exit at 1:22 AM. The read before that is an entry at 12:40 AM.
templates.redHerringDescription: Lost-and-found USB on {name}'s student number. The sticker says 201-KEY. The checkout line says returned at 6 PM.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name}'s USB is a practice set from office hours, turned in at 6 PM.
templates.statementTemplate: I signed out of Furnas 214 at 1:06 AM. I was gone before the printer ran.

templates.title: Ellicott Tunnel Shoulder Check
templates.motive: A project slide one partner deleted.
templates.solvePath: Somebody with tunnel grit on their shoes texted from the Ellicott tunnel at 11:18 PM.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Ellicott tunnel, by the bend.
WHEN: 11:12 PM to 11:28 PM.
WHAT: A student got shouldered into the wall and threatened over a deleted project slide. The cameras catch shoes and coats.
MOTIVE: That deleted slide.

Shoe grit from the tunnel, and a text at 11:18 PM.
Project review sign-out, 11:05 PM.
Project thread. The slide comes out at 10:40 PM.
Phone on a dorm-named Wi-Fi network, 11:20 PM.
A bruise photo, posted at 11:40 PM. Caption reads tunnel night.
templates.accessDescription: Lab note on the shoes {name} wore tonight: grit from the Ellicott tunnel. Their phone sent "I'm in the tunnel, do not follow me" at 11:18 PM.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} was in the Ellicott tunnel at 11:18 PM and started the shove.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed out of the Ellicott project review at 11:05 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is in the project thread. The slide was deleted at 10:40 PM.
templates.alibiDescription: Phone log, 11:20 PM. {name}'s phone is on a network named for the dorm. The IT map for that access point includes the tunnel mouth.
templates.redHerringDescription: Photo {name} posted at 11:40 PM. A fresh bruise. The caption says tunnel night. The file's own clock says 5:12 PM.
templates.redHerringExplanation: The bruise photo on {name}'s phone was taken at rugby practice, 5:12 PM.
templates.statementTemplate: I left the project review and went back to the dorm. I never put a hand on anyone in the tunnel.

templates.title: Goodyear Bike Cage Lock Cut
templates.motive: Sell the bike the same night. They needed the cash.
templates.solvePath: Somebody cut the lock off a blue Trek in the Goodyear cage at 7:22 PM.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Goodyear Hall bike cage.
WHEN: 7:10 PM to 7:40 PM.
WHAT: Somebody cut the lock off a blue Trek and walked it out the south gate.
MOTIVE: Sell it tonight. They needed the cash.

Bike-cage camera still, 7:22 PM. A lanyard, a bolt cutter, the blue Trek.
Intramural check-in sheet, 6:05 PM.
Cage key list.
South-gate counter. A bike leaves at 7:23 PM.
Theater scene-shop checkout. A chain tool, 4:50 PM.
templates.accessDescription: Bike-cage camera GC-1, 7:22 PM. {name}'s lanyard, both hands on a bolt cutter at the blue Trek's lock. The south gate opens in the next frame.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} cut the lock and took the blue Trek from the Goodyear cage at 7:22 PM.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Goodyear intramural sheet at 6:05 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: The facilities key list for the cage doesn't have {name} on it.
templates.alibiDescription: South-gate counter, 7:23 PM. A bike left. {name} isn't printed on the counter slip.
templates.redHerringDescription: Scene-shop checkout. {name} took a chain tool at 4:50 PM. The return line is signed before 6 PM.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} used the chain tool on a set piece and brought it back before 6 PM.
templates.statementTemplate: I didn't go to the bike cage tonight. My bike isn't the blue Trek.

templates.title: Lockwood Carrel Threat Notes
templates.motive: A lab partner just got sole credit. They wanted that partner scared.
templates.solvePath: note-final.pdf printed at Lockwood at 7:14 PM from inside the building.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Lockwood Library, carrels 3B and 3C.
WHEN: 6:50 PM to 8:20 PM.
WHAT: Two printed threats were left for a lab partner who just got sole credit on the paper.
MOTIVE: The credit. They wanted that partner scared.

Printer job note-final.pdf, 7:14 PM. Shared account lib-night.
Exit kiosk. OUT at 6:40 PM.
lib-night roster.
Exit turnstile log, and a print-desk unlock at 7:11 PM.
Campus email, 7:20 PM. Sent from the dorm.
templates.accessDescription: Lockwood printer P-3, 7:14 PM. note-final.pdf, from the shared account lib-night. A clerk penciled {name} in the owner blank.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} printed the Lockwood threats at 7:14 PM while their badge was still inside.
templates.signInDescription: {name} pressed the Lockwood exit kiosk OUT at 6:40 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is on the lib-night roster with three other students. Those three badged into Capen at 7:02 PM.
templates.alibiDescription: Lockwood exit turnstile. No read for {name} between 6:40 PM and 8:05 PM. At 7:11 PM the print desk unlocked on that same badge.
templates.redHerringDescription: Campus mail from {name}, 7:20 PM. It calls the lab partner a thief and says they'll answer for the credit. The send address is the dorm.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} sent that email from their room. Their badge isn't the 7:11 PM print-desk unlock.
templates.statementTemplate: I badged out of Lockwood at 6:40 PM. I didn't print anything after that.

templates.title: Abbott Observatory Eyepiece
templates.motive: Somebody needed the glass for a night shoot.
templates.solvePath: The missing eyepiece's serial is scratched into a camera case returned at 9:40 PM.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Abbott Hall, observatory deck.
WHEN: 8:15 PM to 9:05 PM.
WHAT: The main eyepiece left its case. The loan clipboard still says it's on the mount.
MOTIVE: Somebody needed the glass for a night shoot.

Camera case returned to the media lab, 9:40 PM. Grease in the foam, a serial scratched in.
Observatory visitor sheet. In at 7:30 PM, out at 8:05 PM.
Night-shoot request for the quad.
Deck door log.
Afternoon work order to clean a teaching lens.
templates.accessDescription: Media lab return, 9:40 PM. {name}'s camera case. Abbott focus grease on the foam, and the missing eyepiece's serial scratched into it.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} took the Abbott eyepiece and brought it back in their camera case.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Abbott visitor sheet in at 7:30 PM and out at 8:05 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} filed a night-shoot request for the quad.
templates.alibiDescription: Abbott deck door. No read for {name} after 8:05 PM.
templates.redHerringDescription: Work order, 3 PM. {name} logged a tagged teaching lens out and back in. The tag number is on the form.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} moved a tagged teaching lens at 3 PM and logged it back. The missing piece is the untagged eyepiece.
templates.statementTemplate: I left Abbott before 8:15. I shot the quad. I didn't take the glass off the mount.

templates.title: Hochstetter Incubator Left Open
templates.motive: Judging's tomorrow. They wanted the other group's samples dead before that.
templates.solvePath: Incubator B's glove log at 2:22 PM is one student's glove size, and the alarm was acknowledged there.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Hochstetter Hall, incubator B.
WHEN: 2:10 PM to 2:40 PM.
WHAT: Incubator B was left open, the alarm was shut off at the box, and a symposium group's cultures died.
MOTIVE: Judging's tomorrow. They wanted the other group's samples dead before that.

Glove log H-B, 2:22 PM. A glove size, a skipped sanitizer beep, an alarm acknowledge.
Cleanup sign-out sheet, 2:05 PM.
Cleanup rotation list.
Prep-kitchen motion sensor, 2:51 PM.
Gel-pack slip, 9 AM.
templates.accessDescription: Incubator glove log H-B, 2:22 PM. {name}'s glove size. The sanitizer beep was skipped. The alarm was acknowledged on the incubator panel.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} opened incubator B at 2:22 PM and shut the alarm off.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Hochstetter cleanup sheet out at 2:05 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is on the Hochstetter cleanup rotation.
templates.alibiDescription: Prep-kitchen motion sensor. {name}'s badge shows up at 2:51 PM.
templates.redHerringDescription: Gel-pack slip. {name} signed packs out at 9 AM.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} restocked teaching-lab cold packs at 9 AM. Those packs stayed in the teaching lab.
templates.statementTemplate: I finished cleanup and I was in the prep kitchen. I didn't touch that alarm.

templates.title: Silverman Reserve Textbook Lift
templates.motive: The 5 PM midterm uses problems that are only in that edition.
templates.solvePath: The reserve-desk camera shows the green Organic II spine leaving at 3:28 PM.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Silverman Library, reserve desk.
WHEN: 3:15 PM to 3:40 PM.
WHAT: The two-hour reserve copy of Organic II left while the clerk was in the stacks. Nobody scanned it out.
MOTIVE: The 5 PM midterm uses problems that are only in that edition.

Reserve-desk camera, 3:28 PM. Somebody behind the counter, then the green spine under a notebook.
Organic II waitlist, 2:50 PM.
5 PM midterm roster.
Carrel lamp log. The lamp goes off at 3:10 PM.
Bookstore receipt. A copy of Organic II, 9:15 AM.
templates.accessDescription: Reserve-desk camera SR-D, 3:28 PM. {name} steps behind the counter while the clerk's gone, then leaves with the green Organic II spine under a notebook.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} took the Silverman reserve copy of Organic II at 3:28 PM.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Organic II waitlist at 2:50 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is on the 5 PM Organic II roster.
templates.alibiDescription: A Silverman carrel lamp under {name} turns off at 3:10 PM.
templates.redHerringDescription: Campus bookstore receipt, 9:15 AM. {name} bought a copy of Organic II.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name}'s bought copy is still in their locker with the receipt tucked in it.
templates.statementTemplate: I waited for Organic II and then I left. I didn't go behind the reserve counter.

templates.title: Crosby Greenhouse Pane Break
templates.motive: The gardener wouldn't give out cuttings.
templates.solvePath: Jog camera at 6:12 AM shows shoes that match the soil under the broken cutting-bench pane.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Crosby greenhouse, cutting bench.
WHEN: 5:55 AM to 6:25 AM.
WHAT: One pane over the cutting bench was smashed inward. Soil from the bed is on the brick outside.
MOTIVE: The gardener wouldn't give out cuttings.

Sunrise jog camera, 6:12 AM. Shoes with greenhouse soil.
Dawn facilities sign-in, 5:40 AM. Exterior routes.
Gardener's log. A request for cuttings, refused.
Service-road radio check, 6:05 AM.
Work order for a Crosby pane in bay 2.
templates.accessDescription: Jog camera CJ-1, 6:12 AM. {name} leaving Crosby. The shoes in the frame match the soil sample from under the broken cutting-bench pane.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} broke the Crosby cutting-bench pane and left at 6:12 AM with that soil on their shoes.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the dawn facilities sheet at 5:40 AM for exterior routes.
templates.rosterDescription: The gardener's log says {name} asked for cuttings yesterday and was told no.
templates.alibiDescription: Service-road radio, 6:05 AM. {name} called in a check from the service road.
templates.redHerringDescription: Work order with {name}'s name on it. Bay 2, a cracked pane logged last week, scheduled for tomorrow.
templates.redHerringExplanation: The work order with {name} on it is bay 2. The broken glass this morning is the cutting bench, bay 5.
templates.statementTemplate: I was on the service road at dawn. I didn't go into the greenhouse.

templates.title: Slee Practice-Room Amp
templates.motive: A show tonight, and their own amp died.
templates.solvePath: A 10:05 PM photo shows the Slee house-amp serial while room 3 is still signed out.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Slee Hall, practice room 3.
WHEN: 9:30 PM to 10:15 PM.
WHAT: The house amp left practice room 3. The key never hit the return box.
MOTIVE: A show tonight, and their own amp died.

Photo at 10:05 PM. A hallway outlet, and the house-amp serial sticker in the crop.
Recital-crew sheet. Crew ended at 9:00 PM.
Room 3 reservation card. Return line blank.
Key-return box. No drop tonight.
Reservation note for 8 AM. The note says borrowing the loud one.
templates.accessDescription: Photo from {name}'s account, 10:05 PM. A hallway outlet. The Slee house-amp serial sticker is readable in the crop. Room 3 was still signed out to {name}.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} took the Slee room 3 amp and photographed the serial at 10:05 PM.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Slee recital-crew sheet. Crew ended at 9:00 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} reserved room 3 until 9:20 PM. The return line is blank.
templates.alibiDescription: Slee key-return box. No drop under {name} tonight.
templates.redHerringDescription: {name} reserved room 3 for 8 AM and wrote "borrowing the loud one" on the note.
templates.redHerringExplanation: The note on {name}'s card is for a reservation that starts at 8 AM.
templates.statementTemplate: I returned the practice-room key before 9:30. I didn't take the amp.

templates.title: Baldy Hall False Alarm Pull
templates.motive: They weren't ready to sit that quiz.
templates.solvePath: The pull-station camera at 8:11 PM shows a directory bracelet and a quiz lanyard on the lever.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: Baldy Hall, third floor, by the pull station.
WHEN: 8:05 PM to 8:20 PM.
WHAT: Somebody pulled the fire alarm during a quiz. No smoke. The building emptied.
MOTIVE: They weren't ready to sit that quiz.

Pull-station camera, 8:11 PM. A bracelet and a quiz lanyard on the lever.
Quiz scratch sheet, 8:00 PM.
Third-floor section list.
Stairwell camera, 8:13 PM. Somebody heading down.
Health-desk photo of a burn dressing, 11 AM.
templates.scene: Baldy Hall, third floor, by the pull station
templates.accessDescription: Pull-station camera BA-3, 8:11 PM. {name}'s directory bracelet and quiz lanyard on the lever as it's pulled.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} pulled the Baldy third-floor alarm at 8:11 PM.
templates.signInDescription: Quiz scratch sheet. {name} was marked present at 8:00 PM and absent after the pull.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is on the third-floor section list.
templates.alibiDescription: Stairwell camera BA-S, 8:13 PM. {name} heading down.
templates.redHerringDescription: Health-desk photo, 11 AM. {name} has a fresh burn dressing on one hand.
templates.redHerringExplanation: The burn on {name}'s hand was dressed at the health desk at 11 AM, after a morning lab.
templates.statementTemplate: I was in the quiz room when the alarm went. I didn't touch the pull station.

templates.title: O'Brian Registrar Grade Flip
templates.solvePath: A grade-change form saved at 12:41 AM on a registrar session that never switched users.
templates.briefing:
WHERE: O'Brian Hall, registrar suite.
WHEN: 12:20 AM to 12:55 AM.
WHAT: Somebody saved a grade change on a registrar computer. The author line on the form is blank.
MOTIVE: One course grade, changed overnight.

Grade-form save, 12:41 AM. Author line blank.
Student-worker close sheet, 11:50 PM, and a building-clear line at 12:10 AM.
Session on the registrar computer. Opened at 11:40 PM.
Suite badge read, 12:33 AM.
Night-class roster. Let out at 12:30 AM.
templates.accessDescription: Registrar terminal REG-4, 12:41 AM. A grade-change form, author line blank. The session is the one opened at 11:40 PM. No user switch. {name} is the closer signed on that computer.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} came back into the registrar suite and saved the grade change at 12:41 AM.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the student-worker close sheet at 11:50 PM and the building-clear line at 12:10 AM.
templates.rosterDescription: REG-4 shows no user switch after the session opened at 11:40 PM. It was still open at 12:41 AM. {name} is the closer on the sign-on sheet.
templates.redHerringDescription: {name} is on the O'Brian night-class roster that let out at 12:30 AM. The changed grade is in a course they're failing.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} was in the lecture hall for that night class. Their badge doesn't read the registrar suite.
templates.statementTemplate: I signed the clear line at 12:10 AM. I didn't go back into the suite.
